purpose: One source-authentic BTCUSDT Bybit SPOT Level50 public WebSocket snapshot to bound visible bid/ask spread and simple 500 USDT quote-notional instantaneous marketability proxy; more economically grounded than last-trade prices but still NOT a fill or forward MR40 result.
data_contract: Source topic exact, type snapshot, data.s BTCUSDT, data.b descending price and data.a ascending price with price/size >0, numeric server ts and matching-engine cts, independent device receipt UTC, valid spread ask>bid. No depth merge or inference from delta. Drop if cannot receive and validate first full snapshot.
fixed_cost_method: At one snapshot, marketable buy 500 quote USDT by consuming visible ask levels at face values, obtaining BTC; simultaneously hypothetical sell precisely this acquired BTC against visible bid levels; cost = 500 - bid-side proceeds. Compare with top bid/ask mid and best half-spread separately; exclude all fees, changes over time, RPI, true order fills, actual market impact, order placement time and latency; report order-book shown liquidity is not guaranteed fill.
data_quality_limit: Bybit publicly documents Spot orderbook.50 snapshot then delta and excludes RPI orders. This isolated snapshot is not a complete book nor an executable guarantee. Single time sample is not representative of market conditions near MR40 signals.
live_source_gate: Read-only observation cannot and will not bypass historical missing Oct22 4h market archive gap or activate paper.
